name: edgerun-frontend
description: EdgeRun WebGL frontend and protocol UI surfaces.

scripts.build:chat-wasm: cargo build --manifest-path ../crates/protocol/edgerun-work/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release --example chat_wasm --no-default-features --features wasm-chat && sh -c 'target_dir=${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/cargo-target}; cp "$target_dir/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/examples/chat_wasm.wasm" ./edgerun_chat.wasm'
scripts.build:frontend-wasm: cargo build --manifest-path ../crates/edgerun-codex/Cargo.toml -p edgerun-frontend-web --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && sh -c 'target_dir=${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/cargo-target}; cp "$target_dir/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/edgerun_frontend_web.wasm" ./edgerun_frontend.wasm'
